case.summary: This case was triggered by an analyst request to review transaction 3478561 on card C13487-K1 and related activity showing purchases from an unusual device profile. The graph showed the flagged card connected to 27 other cards through a shared device profile, which was also linked to four confirmed closed cases. The verdict is fraud with an initial and final fraud probability of 0.89, based on multiple independent lines of evidence including an anonymous proxy, new device status, and historical case matches. The case has been escalated for analyst review, and initial actions include blocking the card pending approval.
